description: A self-hosted fast CI runner for GitLab: persistent BuildKit daemons with a shared cache on dedicated build nodes, and a gitlab-runner that sends CI jobs to them.
Persistent BuildKit daemons as a shared build service for CI, with probe and garbage-collection defaults derived from a production setup.
Collects the build history of BuildKit daemons and the CI jobs around it, and explains every build: what came from cache, what came from another job, and why a step was rebuilt.
